title: EvaluationEvent
$comment: AI-ASSISTED SCAFFOLD (WP §13.3, C-BLOCK-07). Privacy-minimised telemetry event. additionalProperties:false makes it impossible to add raw utterances, exact location or free text by construction. Bind to RATIFY-14-11 / governance before collection; transient-by-default.
description: One semantically meaningful, privacy-minimised evaluation event. Never log raw utterances, exact location, access needs or free text.

episode_id.description: Pseudonymous or ephemeral; never a stable personal identifier.

duration_ms.description: Duration only, as approved — not a wall-clock personal timestamp.

accessibility_mode.description: Only if voluntarily and safely captured; never a disability identity.
